erc_warnings.message: Net 'VZ' has input pins but no output driver

text_annotations.text: Transformer secondary 12-15 VAC, 1.5 A or more for full stereo power (12 VAC: regulated to 0.35 A).
J5: LED on the volume board via 2 wires (pin 1 = anode/+). Fit D7 or J5, not both.
J2: 12 V DC straight to VOUT through D8 (0.4 V drop). Bypasses the regulator and the current clamp.
Pass transistor Q2 needs a heatsink: 1.6 W at 12 VAC / 1 A, 4.9 W at 15 VAC / 1.1 A (psu.cir).

observations: Low assembly complexity (score 31/100) — hand assembly feasible
